svg.title: Gavnel, Medal, and Outplayed at a glance
svg.desc: All three save local files. Gavnel has no ads, paid plans, or cloud uploads. Medal and Outplayed have ads on the free tier, optional Premium, and optional uploads. Gavnel needs no account; Medal and Outplayed require accounts. Gavnel and Medal are standalone; Outplayed requires Overwolf to be installed. Interface language and regional options: Gavnel 86, with independent native-speaker review pending; Medal 22; Outplayed 1, English.

g.text: Three ways to keep a moment.
